method: Temporary synthetic index and inline disabled monitor with actions empty; never write fixtures into production files or wazuh-alerts indices
mapping: date_detection=false; timestamp=date; agent.id/location/rule.id and all data.capstone_norm fields used by the query=keyword
time_base: B clock immediately before each inline execute, epoch milliseconds; event_time_kst=T-1s; timestamp=T-1s

runtime_fields.correlation_key: 64 lowercase hex of deterministic synthetic service identity
runtime_fields.correlation_dedupe_key: 64 lowercase hex of deterministic synthetic source/event identity
runtime_fields.message_sha256: 64 lowercase hex of synthetic metadata only

query_rejection_cases: event older than 60s with still-fresh label
invalid date or missing required field
missing/wrong producer marker or correlation policy
multiple distinct values in source/key/tuple fields
source_type_limit: A repeated-identical keyword array can have one docvalue and is not rejected by docvalues alone; actual producer validation and Wazuh leaf provenance remain required
validator_cases_without_inducing_cluster: clock end at now-15s/now+5s allowed; beyond either bound unavailable
old periodEnd unavailable even if fake result contains matching service
ctx.error present or missing results unavailable
hits relation gte or 10001 documents unavailable
service terms omitted documents or 101 buckets unavailable
malformed bucket/key/count, unsorted or duplicate keys unavailable
source count sum differs from service count unavailable
unique-key sum_other_doc_count positive with five returned keys remains available
validator_method: Use the exact production validation-function prefix in an inline test trigger with a separately constructed synthetic ctx map and Instant.ofEpochMilli. Label this as validator execution, not a real shard failure or query replay. Never add bypass/test parameters to production monitor.
outputs: Scenario name, candidate hashes, aggregate counts, Boolean decisions, and fixed error category only; no documents or credentials
cleanup: Delete only the exact random temporary index created by this run; verify removal. No monitor is saved and no production index/template/mapping is changed. Inline dryrun can initialize native alert infrastructure and is not described as wholly read-only.
